definitions: A religious belief among some Christians that financial blessing and physical well-being are always the will of God for them, and that faith, positive speech, and donations to religious causes will increase one's material wealth.
A theological doctrine holding that material wealth and good health are signs of divine favor and that believers can claim these blessings through prayer and faith.
examples: Many televangelists preach the prosperity gospel.
Critics argue the prosperity gospel exploits the poor.
She grew up in a church that embraced the prosperity gospel.
